title: PBA: Same 'old' Calvin Abueva impacts big Converge win off the bench

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Delta Pineda describing Calvin Abueva as an old man has been a running gag ever since the veteran forward has been with Converge. But Abueva’s contribution in the FiberXers’ Game 3 victory over the Rain or Shine Elasto Painters in the PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals on Tuesday was no laughing matter for Pineda. “Kahit matanda na yun, yung energy na kino-contribute niya every time pumapasok siya, nandun pa rin po,” the Converge coach said of Abueva after the 105-89 win in Dasmariñas, Cavite. (Even though he’s old, he always gives us energy every time he comes into the game.) READ: […]... Keep on reading: PBA: Same 'old' Calvin Abueva impacts big Converge win off the bench
